title: Sales Order — a confirmed customer commitment
description: A sales order is what a quotation becomes once the customer commits: it carries a delivery commitment date and, once submitted, it is the document the delivery note is fulfilled against. The state enum is parity-locked to workflows/sales-order.yaml.

delivery_date.description: The delivery commitment the fulfilment documents are measured against.

quotation.description: The quotation this order was raised from, when it was. Optional: an order may be raised directly.

po_reference.description: The customer's own purchase-order reference, printed on our documents.

harvest: the sales order field surface (delivery_date, po_reference, quotation link, taxes, totals)
the forward link from an order to the quotation that produced it
the state set the selling cycle drives an order through
x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream sales order doctype, re-expressed. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
